observation.detail: capability_library consulted first, per the approved specification, before any network research. Catalogue queried twice: (a) capabilities=[browser.screenshot], need='render an HTML page and produce a PNG screenshot using a local headless browser' -> 10 candidates from 43 examined; (b) capabilities=[browser.automation,browser.screenshot] restricted to kinds=[mcp_server,agent_skill], need='headless chromium or playwright already installed locally on the host for HTML to PNG rendering' -> 3 candidates from 5 examined. Preserved candidate evidence (all trust_state=UNVETTED, execution_authority=false, approved=false): cap_48c31e1ffa04c91de3657e08fe85e980a6c892db puppeteer/puppeteer (browser.automation,browser.screenshot, score 70, https://github.com/puppeteer/puppeteer); cap_ba31bde2dfc28f63582ffedfebd302c295c4fa85 microsoft/playwright-mcp (browser.automation,browser.screenshot,mcp.server, score 111.88 / 61.71, https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-mcp); cap_aaf27143872fdfa660bc5ae0d3ba6baecd43fd0e sensepost/gowitness; cap_f631cd8b61103bf3014815b0ceb8968bccdbc496 opennookorg/screenshot-studio; cap_3fbb0d0462685f17c7ee5a52ebbeb07b49bd094f lightpanda-io/browser; cap_5f1572a7669adcb566d54001eb4fdbd8ebe8d66d lackeyjb/playwright-skill. No hazards were flagged on these rows. Per the catalogue note and the approved acceptance criterion, this metadata is NOT execution authority: it proves a candidate exists in the index and nothing more. Bounded local availability check outcome: this delegation was granted only capability_library, file_list and save_artifact. No shell/runtime execution tool was granted (file_list on /usr/bin returned 'Access denied: path is outside the mission workspace'; workspace listing returned only this delegation's own artifacts). Therefore the prescribed tiny HTML/PNG probe could not be run: no exit status, no PNG signature and no dimensions could be read. A probe script was authored and saved as probe_local_renderer.sh for a future grant holder, but authoring it is not execution and confers no evidence. Per the terminal-status rule, nothing was acquired and no fallback was invented. No package was installed, no host configuration changed, no candidate was executed, no network research was performed, and no grant was expanded. Detail of what a qualified run must still establish: presence of an absolute local renderer path (chromium/google-chrome/headless_shell or a playwright/node install), a successful HTML->PNG render, exit status 0, PNG magic bytes 89 50 4E 47 0D 0A 1A 0A, and declared pixel dimensions.

nodes.task: Investigate and acquire a reusable way to provide the missing capability 'missing-browser-renderer'. Reason: Probe the approved UCL acquisition path before web research. Discover existing local or mature open-source options, When capability_library is available, consult it first for unvetted reusable candidates before reaching for the network. Its metadata never approves, installs or executes a candidate and does not replace concrete feasibility and security verification. Evaluate concrete feasibility and security, and where possible use an already-approved tool or local runtime to establish the capability. Do not install packages, change host configuration, purchase anything, expand scope or claim success from documentation alone. Persist a concise JSON observation with capability, status (available|missing|failed), detail and optional acquired. Omit acquired when nothing was acquired; do not use null. When present, acquired must be one short string naming the approved tool or absolute local procedure, never an object; keep commands, hashes and probe evidence in detail. Use exact absolute runtime paths supplied in the task; relative runtime paths resolve to the mission directory and are not a valid absence check. This acquisition is already authorized within the existing approved tool grants: do not require a second mapping-approval record. For a local renderer, a tiny HTML/PNG probe in the mission workspace is sufficient verification when its exit status, PNG signature and dimensions are checked. If status is missing or failed, the observation is terminal: do not invent a fallback or expand grants.
